3 03-11-2025 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.

2. The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 1667 of 2023,
Trial No. 4047 of 2024 registered for the offence punishable under Sections 323, 498A, 504, 506 read with 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections  of the D.P. Act.
3. As per the prosecution case, the petitioner and the co-accused persons are alleged to have tortured the complainant mentally and physically due to non-fulfillment of demand of dowry.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.50220 of 2025(3) dt.03-11-2025 that the petitioner has falsely been implicated in this case.
There is general and omnibus allegation against the petitioner who is the husband of the complainant.
The petitioner neither demanded any dowry nor tortured the informant/complainant.

The dispute between both the parties has been resolved amicably on 22.09.2025 through the process of Mediation Proceeding on the following terms and conditions:-
1. That after great persuasion both the parties agreed to live separately and for this the petitioner (Munna Sah) offered to pay Rs. 3,10,000/- (Rupees Three Lakhs Ten Thousand Only) as full and final settlement amount to the Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.50220 of 2025(3) dt.03-11-2025 Opposite Party No. 2 (Baby Devi @ Babi Devi).

Opposite Party No. 2 accepted the offer and gave her consent.
2. That the husband/petitioner agreed to pay the aforesaid settlement amount in the sum of Rs. 3,10,000/-
(Rupees Three Lakhs Ten Thousand Only) in three installments in following manner:-

3 . The petitioner (Munna Sah) has been paid in first installment of Rs.
1,10,000/- (Rupees One Lakh Ten Thousand) through Bank Draft No. 616990, dated 20.09.2025 issued by the Bank of Baroda in the name of Opposite Party No. 2 Baby Devi @ Babi Devi and the Opposite Party No. 2 accepted the same and second installment of Rs.
1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh Only) shall be pay after withdrawing the Siwan Complaint Case No.
1667 of 2023 by the learned Court below and third and final installment of Rs. 1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh Only) at the time of grant of decree of divorce with mutual consent of the parties U/s 13(B) of Hindu Marriage Act before the Family Court, Siwan.
The payment shall be made through Bank Draft/RTGS/issued in the name of Opposite Party No. 2 namely Baby Devi @ Babi Devi.

4. That both the parties have agreed to file the mutual divorce petition in terms of Section 13(B) of the Hindu Marriage Act, before the Principal Judge, Family Court, Siwan within one month from date of furnishing of bail bond.
5. That both the parties have further agreed to withdraw respective cases Civil/Criminal in nature filed against each Patna High Court CR.
in the light of settlement of dispute soon after filing of the mutual divorce petition.
6. This settlement shall be full and final settlement and no party shall claim in future against each other, in any manner.

5.
Learned A.P.P. for the State has vehemently opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner.

6. Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, let the above named petitioner, in the event of his arrest/surrender within a period of six weeks from today, be enlarged on anticipatory bail on furnishing bail-bond of Rs.
20,000/- (Rupees twenty thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned court concerned, Patna High Court CR.

MISC. No.50220 of 2025(3) dt.03-11-2025 S.D.J.M., Siwan in connection with Complaint Case No. 1667/2023, Trial No. 4047 of 2024 subject to conditions as laid down under section 482(2) of the B.N.S.S, with further condition:-

(i). The petitioner is directed to remain physically present before the learned Court below on each and every date, failing which on two consecutive dates without reasonable cause, the bail bonds of the petitioner are liable to be cancelled.

7. If so advised, either of the parties will be at liberty to make an application before the Court below for referring the matter to the District Mediation Centre for the purpose of reconcilation or one time settlement.
8. The application stands allowed.
